# Apex LSP Jar Provenance

- `vendor/apex-jorje-lsp.jar`

- Source repo: https://github.com/forcedotcom/salesforcedx-vscode

- Source commit (mirror import): `67dc27932e0ce43b93abe00878a2f966d0eb16a3`
